# Ridu 0.11.1

This patch completes the hidden-resource and admin-only migration behavior introduced in 0.11.0.

## Fixes

- Hidden collection and global routes now use the localized not-found page title instead of
  exposing the resource name in the browser tab. This also applies to create, API, versions,
  and custom document-view routes.
- `ridu migrate create` now reports that no migration is needed and writes no file when only
  admin presentation settings changed. Migrations containing storage-schema changes or
  executable planner/data steps remain available. The next schema migration records the
  current admin settings too.

## Upgrade

Update the Go module and all Ridu npm packages to 0.11.1 together, regenerate application
contracts, and rebuild with the matching CLI. This patch changes no public API signatures,
manifest/protocol versions, plugin contracts, or persisted migration encodings. Keep existing
migration artifacts and database ledgers; these fixes require no new application migration.
